upstream.revision_evidence: The main question collection and train split in the archive match the Git blob IDs at this revision on the Hugging Face mirror.

split.sampling: Seeded pilot. All eight models used the same questions in the same frozen order.

scoring.procedure: Astra reviewed answers against the questions, supplied materials, author references and review criteria. The five-model batch retained its prior reviews. The three-model batch received a full review of each valid answer.
scoring.strict_accuracy_upper: The sum of C and U divided by 150 per model

rights.evidence: The dataset card and file inventory for the wanhaoliu release were checked via the Hugging Face mirror. The card has no license field or redistribution restriction.

related_releases.scope_note: The code repository asks for a final license file and points to the weidawang data package.
The license field identifies the separately packaged Parquet release. Its applicability to the archived package is unverified.
